title: Bismuth-magnesium sample said to be from Roswell, found in an army officer's grandfather's archives
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bismuth-magnesium sample said to be from Roswell, found in an army officer's grandfather's archives, about 1947 at Roswell, New Mexico, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Long story short, this army officer was going through his grandfather's archives when he found this rare sample. And then written in the diary was that it was a piece from uh Roswell.
looked at the magnesium bismuth piece from roswell which was i guess a grandfather who was a colonel in the roswell cleanup collection this was sort of left in the safe and the grandson found it
tellings.difference: This telling makes the grandfather a colonel in the Roswell cleanup and says the piece was left in a safe, where the story has it in archives with a diary note, and it credits nobody rather than Hal Puthoff.
tellings.link_reason: Both tellings are about the same bismuth-magnesium sample said to come from Roswell 1947, which a grandson found among his grandfather's belongings.

as_told.title: Roswell magnesium-bismuth piece found in grandfather's safe

tellings.quote: One of his pieces that we looked at together when I visited was magnesium bismuth.
tellings.difference: This telling puts the piece with Garry Nolan at Stanford, where Michels saw it during a visit, and it does not mention Roswell or the army officer's grandfather's archives.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the same magnesium-bismuth crash fragment, which Jesse Michels says he looked at in person. The story's host telling already has him looking at the magnesium-bismuth piece from Roswell, and this telling places that same viewing with Garry Nolan.

tellings.quote: Gary Nolan from Jacqu Valet has these magnesium bismouth parts that he thinks came from Roswell
tellings.difference: Says the piece came to Nolan through Jacques Vallée and ties it to Townsend Brown's use of bismuth.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the magnesium-bismuth piece said to come from Roswell that Nolan holds.

as_told.title: Nolan's magnesium-bismuth Roswell parts and Townsend Brown's bismuth

tellings.quote:
And that was found maybe with a UFO
and they think maybe so you could have
magnetic levitation.
tellings.difference: Does not name Roswell and adds a guess that the material allows magnetic levitation.
tellings.link_reason: This is the bismuth piece said to have been found with a UFO, which is the Roswell bismuth-magnesium sample the host tells about elsewhere.

as_told.title: Bismuth reportedly found with a UFO and possible magnetic levitation

related.note: The same magnesium-bismuth piece in Nolan's Stanford lab, but this telling attributes it to Ubatuba, Brazil, where the story says it came from Roswell.
